title: Cloudbeds Rate Plan
description: JSON Schema for a Cloudbeds rate plan as returned by the Cloudbeds REST API v1.3 rate plan endpoints.

ratePlanID.description: Cloudbeds-assigned identifier for the rate plan.

propertyID.description: Identifier for the Cloudbeds property the rate plan belongs to.

name.description: Human-readable name for the rate plan.

description.description: Public-facing description of the rate plan.

roomTypeID.description: Identifier for the room type the rate plan applies to.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the rate plan.

rates.description: Per-day rates that make up the rate plan.

isActive.description: Whether the rate plan is currently active.

isBaseRate.description: Whether the rate plan is the property's base rate.

isDerived.description: Whether the rate plan is derived from another rate plan.

derivedFromRatePlanID.description: Identifier of the parent rate plan when isDerived is true.

channelDistribution.description: Distribution channels mapped to this rate plan.
